title: Diversity of EML-type operators
abstract: arXiv:2609.11210v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The discovery of the EML operator, sufficient to evaluate the standard explicit purely transcendental elementary functions, has led to considerable interest and discussion across multiple scientific disciplines. However, most authors have focused on the binary EML itself, while numerous similar variants with slightly different properties are now known. This article attempts to close this gap by enumerating and classifying them. We also take this opportunity to clarify common misconceptions related to the EML operator. The principal goal, symbolic regression within an architecture as close as possible to proven neural networks which combine matrix multiplication with a single univariate non-linear activation function, remains beyond reach. Instead, we propose a M\"obius layer, with rational functions replacing matrix operations, and showcase the recently discovered activation function eml(x,1/x), which allows exp(x) and ln(x) to be reco

translated_abstract: EML算子的发现——它足以计算标准的显式纯超越初等函数——已在多个科学学科中引起了相当大的兴趣和讨论。然而，大多数研究者都聚焦于二元EML本身，而目前已知有许多性质略有差异的类似变体。本文试图通过枚举和分类这些变体来填补这一空白，并借此机会澄清与EML算子相关的常见误解。其主要目标——在尽可能接近成熟神经网络架构（即将矩阵乘法与单个单变量非线性激活函数相结合）的框架内实现符号回归——仍然未能实现。取而代之的是，我们提出了一个默比乌斯层，用有理函数取代矩阵运算，并展示了最近发现的激活函数eml(x,1/x)，该函数能够恢复出exp(x)和ln(x)。
tldr: 本文枚举并分类了多种EML型算子变体，澄清了相关误解，并提出了用有理函数替代矩阵运算的默比乌斯层以及能够恢复exp(x)和ln(x)的新型激活函数eml(x,1/x)。
en_tdlr: This paper enumerates and classifies the diversity of EML-type operator variants, clarifies common misconceptions, and proposes a Möbius layer replacing matrix operations with rational functions, showcasing the activation function eml(x,1/x) capable of recovering exp(x) and ln(x).
